channel.title: Alabama Political Reporter - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Alabama Political Reporter (alreporter.com)

item.title: Alabama CHOOSE Act application portal dates released for 2026-2027
item.description: Gov. Kay Ivey released key application dates for the CHOOSE Act, Alabama's education savings account program, allowing families to prepare for the 2026-2027 school year.

item.title: Redemption Earned wins J.M.K. Innovation Prize for Alabama prison work
item.description: Redemption Earned, which provides legal aid to Alabama's elderly and infirm prisoners, was awarded the $175,000 2025 J.M.K. Innovation Prize.

item.title: Alabama Farmers Federation endorses Rep. James Lomax for HD20
item.description: The state's largest farm organization announced Wednesday it had "complete confidence" Lomax would remain a strong conservative voice in Montgomery.

item.title: Governor visits ALDOT workers as Capitol Christmas tree lighting ceremony is set
item.description: Gov. Kay Ivey personally checked in with ALDOT crews responsible for transforming the front steps of the State Capitol for the annual Christmas tree lighting.

item.title: Opinion | 2026 governor’s race and all state races right around the corner
item.description: Tommy Tuberville’s decision to leave his U.S. Senate seat for governor cleared the field, but key races remain for attorney general and lieutenant governor.

item.title: CAIR denounces Tuberville’s call for immigration ban on Middle East, North Africa
item.description: Sen. Tommy Tuberville claimed the D.C. shooting necessitated banning immigration from the Middle East and North Africa, prompting CAIR to call the remarks “unhinged.”

item.title: Anti-death penalty coalition talks surge in executions, dwindling public support
item.description: The new US Campaign to End the Death Penalty argued the surge in executions, especially in the South, was disconnected from current public opinion.

item.title: Opinion | CHOOSE Act steals money from public schools to pay sketchy private vendors
item.description: Thanks to ALGOP's CHOOSE Act, hundreds of millions in tax dollars are now paying for absurdly inaccurate and laughably partisan school textbooks and materials.

item.title: Alabama Ethics Commission sees increase in municipal FCPA appeals
item.description: The Alabama Ethics Commission saw an uptick in municipal FCPA as a result of the new filing process.

item.title: Opinion | When hatred becomes policy, the Constitution is the casualty
item.description: Religious fear, power and constitutional restraint collide in Alabama after rhetoric turns a zoning dispute into a test of democracy.
